add_point.description: Create a point inside a piece. Omitted role means cut; annotation points are sewing marks.

move_point.description: Move an existing point to new coordinates.

add_line.description: Create a straight segment between two points.

add_curve.description: Create a cubic Bézier curve through four control points.

add_arc.description: Create a circular arc through three points: start, end and a point on the arc.

add_circle.description: Create a circle from a centre point and a rim point; the radius is their distance.

set_role.description: Assign an entity a cut, construction or annotation role. Text is always annotation and cannot be changed.

delete_entity.description: Remove an entity and its dependent constraints and texts. A loop edge leaves a broken loop; the piece survives.

add_constraint.description: Attach a geometric constraint to one or more entities. A distance without a value is a driven dimension; a distance with a reference follows another dimension.

update_constraint.description: Change a dimensional constraint value or its dimension presentation.

remove_constraint.description: Detach a constraint from the sketch.

add_corner_round.description: Round a corner between two lines, trimming both to a tangent arc.

set_corner_round_radius.description: Change the radius of a corner round and regenerate its tangent points and arc.

remove_corner_round.description: Restore a rounded corner to the sharp intersection.

create_piece.description: Create an empty piece. Its cut loop is captured later with set_piece_loop.

set_piece_loop.description: Store an ordered closed chain of the piece's own cut edges, or clear it with an empty list.

move_piece.description: Translate every point the piece owns, including fixed points, as one undoable step.

add_text.description: Place a one-line annotation label at a point of its piece.

update_text.description: Edit a label's content, anchor, alignment, rotation, size or leader.

update_piece.description: Rename a piece or change its cut quantity.

delete_piece.description: Remove a piece and cascade its owned geometry, constraints, texts, rounds and cut dimensions.

set_piece_allowance.description: Set, change or remove the allowance of one piece loop edge.

set_default_allowance.description: Set, change or clear the allowance copied onto newly created pieces.

add_derived_dimension.description: Add a read-only cut dimension between two corners or straight edges of one piece.

params.a: cut_anchor { edge: entity_id, at: start|end|edge, loop: stitch|cut? }
params.b: cut_anchor { edge: entity_id, at: start|end|edge, loop: stitch|cut? }

solve.description: Rebuild the sketch by running the constraint solver.
